title: Prices, Prices, Prices: Overall Inflation and the Costs You Care About - Liberty Street Economics
gist: NY Fed's Athreya explains the Fed targets average inflation, not individual prices: narrow shocks like pumpkins wash out, broad ones like fertilizer matter, and the Fed's job is anchoring expectations via the policy rate relative to neutral so shocks stay temporary.

insights.claim: Inflation is a budget-weighted average of price changes, so small-share items like pumpkins barely affect it while food, near 10% of a typical household budget, does.
insights.speaker: Kartik B. Athreya
insights.so_what: Weight, not salience, determines whether a price move shows up in inflation.

insights.claim: The Fed cannot set individual prices; its role is to keep the typical price change small, and it need not respond to isolated sector shocks.
insights.speaker: Kartik B. Athreya
insights.so_what: Fed will look through narrow supply shocks.
insights.quote: we cannot affect any individual price

insights.claim: A widespread shock such as fertilizer demand outrunning capacity raises all food prices persistently and will lift inflation at least temporarily unless the Fed acts hard enough to raise unemployment.
insights.speaker: Kartik B. Athreya
insights.so_what: Commodity input shocks to broad baskets are where the Fed faces a trade-off.

insights.claim: Shocks stay temporary if policy keeps inflation expectations low and stable by clear communication and setting the short-term rate appropriately relative to a neutral rate.
insights.speaker: Kartik B. Athreya
insights.so_what: Expectations anchoring is the Fed's main channel; de-anchoring is the risk to watch.
insights.locator: how does the Fed work to dispel

insights.claim: The New York Fed monitors inflation with tools such as the Survey of Consumer Expectations, the Multivariate Core Trend model, a DSGE model, Outlook-at-Risk and the Global Supply Chain Pressure Index, and has recently studied the drawn-out effects of the 2025-26 tariffs.
insights.speaker: Kartik B. Athreya
insights.so_what: Reference list of indicators to track.
